name: Jenny Clarke
occupation: Lincoln County clerk of district court-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Jenny Clarke is the Lincoln County clerk of district court-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Kenneth D. Roberts, who is serving through the current term. SVI-NEWS reported that her race was decided in the Republican primary and that she was unopposed in the general election (the newspaper listed the name as Jenny Clark).

sources.name: SVI-NEWS, Nov. 3, 2026, 2026 Lincoln County General Election Results
